entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane of five shards, whose Alara Reborn phase is a fusion of shards, cultures and magics in war.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: A figure who delivered a stirring war-speech near a chunk of fallen marble.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: The person who first developed the formula for etherium in a rune-scratched tower.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A figure who first saw blood on the edge of a blade in a dusty arena.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: The material of Esper, whose formula Crucius first developed.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A jungle shard of Alara home to elves, leonin and behemoths.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The rotting undead shard of Alara.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The etherium shard of Alara, home to mentalists and vedalken.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara with strongholds and crossbow-snipers.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The savage shard of Alara home to wurms, goblins and viashino.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest on Dominaria whose out-of-control growth is due largely to the magic of the Mirari.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A magical object whose magic drives the growth of the Krosan Forest.

entities.name: Krosan Cloudscraper
entities.description: A huge beast produced by the Krosan Forest, magically augmented in size.

events.summary: Elvish seers from Naya find new monster-gods on other shards and a Jund wurm moves into Naya, illustrating the fusion of the shards in Alara Reborn.
events.quote: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in the lush, green jungles and stone ruins of Naya.

events.summary: Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, and Naya elves journey through Grixis, as shards collide.
events.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

relations.note: The forest's growth is driven largely by the Mirari's magic.
relations.quote: a forest whose out-of-control growth is due largely to the magic of the Mirari

relations.note: He is a product of the forest.
relations.quote: is the product of the Krosan Forest
